description: Hardening, docs and cleanup: remove the SEED/localStorage remnants and simulated behaviours from the front end, tighten CSP/rate limit/error handling, confirm MVC layering, write README and database README additions, run the full verification (all suites + every page of every portal at 1280/390 + screenshots) and write .be-tmp/report.md. Depends on FEAT-001..005.
steps: Grep src/public for leftovers and remove them: SEED( and the SEED function in data.js (keep fixed reference constants: DOJOS, PKG, CLASSES, OTHER_DOJO_CLASSES, PRIVATE_CLASSES only if still used, BELTS, CURRICULUM, DOGI_SIZES, GRADING_FEE, whyNot as a UX hint), DB_KEY, save(, resetDemo/[data-reset], admSeed, rmSeed, fbSeed, demoOn, simulateTaps, ask-role, ask-admin, ask-last-id, ask-prototype, sessionStorage, localStorage (only ask-rail, ask-home-view, ask-sound UI preferences may remain), `new Date()`/`Date.now()` used for business time (replace with NOW()). Confirm the QR/check-in mock in student.js and checkin.html still works in memory and has no storage calls.

Backend review pass: no SQL string outside src/models (grep for SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE in routes, controllers, services, middleware), every route has auth + role guard where required, every mutating route validated, password_hash/qr_token never selected into responses, error handler hides stack in production, helmet CSP has no violations in the browser run, login rate limit works, JWT_SECRET fail-fast in production verified by starting with NODE_ENV=production and no JWT_SECRET.

Write c:/Users/CedrikHwang/FSDP-C19/README.md (project overview, requirements, install, create database `ask_dojo`, `psql -d ask_dojo -f database/db.sql` and `database/seed.sql`, env vars table incl. JWT_SECRET, JWT_EXPIRES_IN, APP_FAKE_TODAY (dev only, e.g. 2026-11-06), APP_TZ, DB_POOL_MAX, DB_SSL, demo accounts and the password123 note, npm start/dev/test, API prefix /api/v1, folder tree, security notes including the SameSite=Lax + JSON-only CSRF stance, deferred list). Append the backend schema-change notes to database/README.md if FEAT-001 did not finish them.

Create .be-tmp/verify/run-all.mjs that starts the PGlite socket, resets the DB, starts the server, runs every api-*.mjs and browser-*.mjs suite plus api-sqli.mjs, prints a pass/fail table, stops all child processes and removes scratch files. Run it. Fix every failure. Take the final screenshots of the main pages of all four portals into .be-tmp/screens/ (overwrite the old ones).

Run `npm ci` followed by `npm test -- --runInBand` to confirm the CI path, then confirm git state: `git status --short` (nothing staged), `git log -1` unchanged from the start commit, .env / .gitignore / prompts untouched, and a secret scan over new files (no JWT secret value, no passwords except the documented demo password123 in README/seed).

Write c:/Users/CedrikHwang/FSDP-C19/.be-tmp/report.md with: architecture overview and folder tree, endpoint catalogue (from plan.md updated to what was built), page-to-endpoint map, auth design, business rules implemented, schema changes (list every db.sql change), env vars, how to run, whether package.json / package-lock.json are git-ignored (they are not), decisions to confirm (temp passwords for new students and staff, grading notes visible to the student, Retake result, guest pass columns, class_feedback_prompt table, derived level-ups, promotion approval by BA, interventions stored as policy_setting), Deferred (QR/check-in, payments gateway, email/SMS, CSV import pipeline, uploads, real-time, audit log, photos, Google sign-in).
